composition: workforceGlobalDefaults -> notificationEscalationSettings -> runtime hard bounds/state machine
hard_rules: settings may tighten but not loosen workforce acknowledgement/retry/escalation/cooldown floors
HIGH and CRITICAL retain an IN_APP fallback when that channel is runtime-available
HIGH and CRITICAL retain a required escalation path
channel preferences are activated only when present in runtime available_channels
recipient identities and live delivery/escalation state are not stored as generic settings
escalation due is advisory and requires a governed runtime transition
settings never dispatch, escalate, grant authority, satisfy approval, or permit execution
